name: RC Servo
description: Hobby RC servo: body, two mounting ears and an offset output spline — the actuator of small robots and pan-tilt rigs.

name: Servo Horn
description: Plastic servo horn — single, double or cross arm, or a disc — that fits the output spline of an RC servo.

name: NEMA Stepper Motor
description: Hybrid stepper motor: chamfered body, front boss, output shaft and four mounting holes. Pick the frame and body length.

name: Deep Groove Ball Bearing
description: Shielded deep-groove ball bearing modeled as inner + outer races with a recessed shield face.

name: Flanged Ball Bearing
description: Shielded deep-groove ball bearing with an outer-ring flange: press it into a through bore and the flange sets its depth.

name: Pillow Block Bearing
description: Two-bolt pillow block: an insert bearing in a cast housing that carries a shaft parallel to the mounting face (lead-screw end supports).

name: Thrust Ball Bearing
description: Single-direction thrust ball bearing: shaft washer, ball cage and housing washer, carrying axial load (turntables, lead-screw ends).

name: Wire Thread Insert
description: Helical diamond-wire thread insert that repairs or reinforces a tapped hole in soft metal; the STI hole and the screw thread are included.

name: Domed Cap Nut
description: Hexagon domed cap (acorn) nut: a hex, a collar and a hemispherical dome over a blind thread.

name: Hex Flange Nut
description: Hexagon nut with an integral conical flange that spreads the load like a captive washer.

name: Hex Nut
description: Standard metric hexagonal nut with a modeled ISO thread.

name: Hex Nut ISO 4032
description: Regular hexagon nut, style 1, with both bearing faces chamfered at 30° and an optional modeled thread.

name: Nylon Insert Lock Nut
description: Hex nut with a taller body carrying a nylon insert that resists loosening under vibration.

name: Nylon Insert Lock Nut (ISO)
description: Prevailing-torque hex nut: a wrenching hex plus a crimped collar holding a nylon ring whose bore is the thread minor diameter.

name: Square Nut
description: Four-flat square nut, often dropped into channels or held against a flat to stop it turning.

name: T-Slot Nut (6 mm)
description: Slide-in T-nut for the 6 mm slot of 2020/2040 aluminium extrusion: wide flange under the lips, narrow neck through the opening.

name: Thin Hex Nut
description: Reduced-height (jam) hex nut, used as a locknut or where clearance is tight.

name: Thin Hex Nut ISO 4035
description: Thin (jam) hexagon nut, chamfered both sides, used as a lock nut or where height is short.

name: Wing Nut
description: Round-body nut with two upright wings for hand tightening without a tool.

name: Clevis Pin
description: Headed clevis pin; form B has a cross hole for a split pin or R-clip that keeps it in the clevis.

name: Coiled Spring Pin
description: Coiled spring pin: a spring-steel strip rolled 2¼ turns into a spiral that keeps flexing evenly in its H10 hole.

name: Dowel Pin
description: Hardened parallel pin with chamfered ends that locates two parts precisely; press it into a reamed bore.

name: Parallel Pin
description: Unhardened parallel pin with chamfered ends, ground to m6 (press fit in an H7 hole) or h8 (slide fit).

name: R-Clip (spring cotter)
description: R-clip / hitch pin clip: a straight spring-wire leg through the cross hole and a curved leg that snaps over the pin.

name: Slotted Spring Pin
description: Heavy-duty slotted spring pin: a split spring-steel tube, oversize before fitting, that grips its H12 hole.

name: Split Pin
description: Split (cotter) pin: a half-round wire doubled into two legs and an eye; push it through a cross hole and bend the legs apart.

name: External Circlip (shaft)
description: Spring-steel retaining ring that snaps into a shaft groove to stop a bearing, gear or pulley sliding along the shaft.

name: Internal Circlip (bore)
description: Spring-steel retaining ring that snaps into a bore groove to hold a bearing in its housing.

name: Blind Rivet
description: Open-end blind (pop) rivet with dome head and break-pull mandrel, set from one side; drill size and grip range included.

name: Solid Rivet
description: Solid rivet with a round (snap) head or a 75° countersunk head; the closing head is formed from the protruding shank.

name: Button Head Socket Screw
description: Low domed head with a hex (Allen) socket — a rounded, low-profile alternative to the cap screw.

name: Cheese Head Slotted Screw
description: Cylindrical head with a straight screwdriver slot — a classic slotted machine screw.

name: Countersunk Slotted Screw
description: Flat 90° countersunk head with a straight screwdriver slot — sits flush with the surface.

name: Countersunk Socket Screw
description: Flat 90° countersunk head with a hex (Allen) socket — sits flush with the surface.

name: Hex Head Bolt
description: Hexagonal-head bolt. Fully threaded by default; set a grip length for a DIN 931 partial thread.

name: Pan Head Screw (Phillips)
description: Low domed pan head with a Phillips cross recess — the screw for servos, PCBs and small electronics.

name: Set Screw (hex socket)
description: Headless hex-socket grub screw with a flat, cone, dog or cup point — locks a hub or collar on a shaft.

name: Socket Head Cap Screw
description: Hex-socket (Allen) cap-head screw with a modeled ISO metric thread.

name: Wood Screw (countersunk)
description: Pointed, gauge-sized wood screw with a flush countersunk head — the fastener for slat/board construction (decks, chairs, fences).

name: Hex Standoff
description: Hexagonal spacer that holds a PCB or panel off a base: female-female, or male-female with a threaded stud.

name: Heat-Set Insert (brass)
description: Knurled brass insert melted into a 3D-printed pocket to give plastic a metal thread; sits flush with the face.

name: Stud
description: Double-ended stud: a metal end that screws into a tapped hole (1 d for steel, 1.25 d for cast iron), a plain shank and a nut end.

name: Threaded Rod (generic)
description: Fully-threaded metric rod; set the diameter, length and pitch directly.

name: Threaded Rod (metric)
description: Fully-threaded metric rod — pick the size and length; the ISO coarse pitch is applied automatically.

name: Threaded Rod DIN 976-1
standard: DIN 976-1 form A (supersedes DIN 975) · ISO 261 coarse
description: Fully threaded rod cut to length with both ends chamfered to the thread root; nuts run on from either end.

name: Chamfered Flat Washer
description: Plain washer of the ISO 7089 size with a 30° chamfer on the outer edge, for hex bolts and nuts.

name: Fender Washer
description: Oversized-OD flat washer that spreads load over a wide area (~3× the bolt diameter).

name: Flat Washer
description: Plain flat washer that spreads load under a bolt head or nut.

name: Serrated Lock Washer
description: Thin spring-steel lock washer with a ring of teeth on the outside (A) or inside (J) that bite into the head and the seat.

name: Small Flat Washer
description: Small-diameter plain washer for cheese-head and socket screws where a DIN 125 washer is too wide.

name: Split Lock Washer
description: Square-section spring ring with a radial split that bites into the joint to resist loosening.

name: Gearbox Plate
description: Housing side plate of a spur gear stage: two bearing seats at the centre distance module x (z1 + z2) / 2, corner holes for DIN 912 through-bolts and spacers, two mounting holes.

name: Spacer Tube
description: Plain spacer / standoff tube with a clearance bore for a through-bolt; sets the gap between two plates.

name: Spur Gear Stage
description: Self-contained spur gear reduction stage: pinion and gear on two shafts in four deep groove bearings, between two plates held by four spacers and DIN 912 through-bolts with washers and nuts (30 parts).

name: Levelling Foot
description: Levelling foot: a steel base with a hex for the spanner and a threaded spindle that screws into the machine frame.

name: Fixed Handle
description: Turned steel fixed handle (ball grip) with a collar and a threaded pin, screwed into a lever or hand wheel.

name: Ball Knob
standard: DIN 319 (form C tapped / form E threaded bush)
description: Plastic ball knob for levers and spindles, with a blind tapped hole (C) or a threaded bush (E).

name: Lead Screw Nut T8 (brass)
description: Flanged brass nut for the T8 lead screw (trapezoidal thread, matching lead), with four flange mounting holes on a 16 mm circle.

name: Lead Screw T8
description: 8 mm stainless trapezoidal lead screw (30°), 4-start 8 mm lead by default — the standard printer Z-axis drive screw.

name: Linear Ball Bearing (LMxUU)
description: Closed-type linear ball bushing for round rod (LMxUU series sizing).

name: Profile Linear Rail (MGN / HGR)
description: Profile linear guide rail with counterbored mounting holes at the series pitch; an MGN carriage runs along it.

name: Rail Carriage (MGN / HGH)
standard: MGN7 – 15 C / H · HGH15CA · HGH20CA / HA
description: Ball-recirculating carriage block for an MGN rail with four tapped mounting holes on top; runs along the rail on a slider joint.

name: Shaft Support (SK)
description: Aluminium rod-end support: a split clamp bore above a two-bolt foot that holds a smooth rod parallel to the mounting face.

name: Smooth Rod
description: Ground and hardened round rod for linear motion — the rail an LMxUU bearing slides along.

name: V-Wheel (V-slot)
standard: OpenBuilds solid / mini V-wheel · 2 x 625 bearings
description: Delrin V-wheel that rides the V groove of V-slot aluminium extrusion — the roller of V-slot gantry plates.

name: Motor Mount (L-bracket)
description: L-bracket holding a NEMA stepper shaft-up under its horizontal leg (or an idler pulley on an M5 screw), bolted by its vertical leg to a face.

name: Carriage
description: Carriage block riding two smooth rods on four LMxUU bearings, with top mounting holes, an optional lead-screw nut mount and an optional belt clamp.

name: Gantry Carriage
description: Y-axis carriage of an XY gantry: rides two Y rods on four LMxUU bearings, is driven by a T8 lead screw, and holds the two X rods plus side holes for a motor or idler bracket.

name: Rod End Plate
description: Upright end plate holding two smooth rods, with a foot to bolt down and either a NEMA motor face or a 608 idler bearing seat for the lead screw.

name: GT2 Timing Belt (closed loop)
description: Closed GT2 belt wrapped around two pulleys at a centre distance; reports its pitch length and tooth count.

name: Shaft Coupling (clamp)
description: Aluminium clamping coupling with a stepped bore for two shaft diameters and a clamp slit at each end.

name: Gear Rack
description: Straight-toothed gear rack by module and length; mesh it with a spur gear pinion through mesh_rack() and a rack-and-pinion joint relation.

name: Spur Gear
description: Parametric spur gear by module and tooth count, with a central bore. Involute teeth (20° pressure angle) with a little backlash, so gears placed by mesh_gears() do not overlap.

name: GT2 Idler
standard: GT2 · smooth / 20T toothed · 3 or 5 mm bore
description: Flanged belt idler on a bearing: smooth (runs on the belt back) or 20-tooth toothed (runs on the teeth).

name: GT2 Timing Pulley
description: Toothed GT2 timing-belt pulley with flanges and a bore; set the tooth count, bore and belt width.

name: Plain Shaft
description: Plain cylindrical shaft / round stock of the given diameter and length.

name: Shaft Collar
standard: DIN 705 style set-screw / one-piece clamp collar
description: Steel ring locked on a shaft by a set screw or a clamp screw — an axial stop for bearings, pulleys and gears.

name: Aluminium Extrusion (T-slot)
description: Open-builds style aluminium T-slot extrusion with face slots and centre bore(s). Pick the series and cut length.

name: Round Tube
description: Round hollow tube (handrail / structural). Ends carry mating anchors; use tube_tee to cope-join tubes at right angles.

name: Compression Spring
description: Helical compression spring swept from round wire: closed or ground ends, rate, solid length and a stroke check from EN 13906-1.

name: Extension Spring
description: Close-wound helical extension spring swept from round wire, with full German loops or open hooks at both ends; rate and stress from EN 13906-2.

name: Torsion Spring
description: Close-wound helical torsion spring swept from round wire with two straight tangential legs; angular rate and bending stress from EN 13906-3.
